title: PurchaseOrder
description:
A buyer issued purchase contract, also called a purchase order.
Carries all eleven `credentialSubject` properties of the UNVTD purchase order
(https://unvtd.unece.org/docs/purchase-order/#schema). The seller issued
mirror of this document is {@link ITradeAgreement}.
See docs/model-guide.md §2.4 for the property mapping and its trade-offs.

issueDateTime.description: The date the order was issued. UNVTD `orderDate`.

buyerParty.description: The buyer party placing this order. UNVTD `buyer`.

sellerParty.description: The seller party the order is placed with. UNVTD `seller`.

deliveryLocation.description:
Where the goods are to be delivered. UNVTD `deliveryLocation`.
Other places, such as a place of payment presentation, go in the
inherited `applicableLocation`.

includedSupplyChainTradeLineItem.description: An ordered lot. UNVTD `orderedItems`, minimum one.

applicableDeliveryTerms.description:
The delivery terms in coded form: the Incoterm and its named place. The
verbatim source text of the same row is in `basis`.

paymentMethod.description: The means by which payment is to be made. UNVTD `paymentMethod`.

allowanceCharge.description: An allowance or charge applied to this order. UNVTD `allowanceCharge`.

totalOrderAmount.description: The total amount of this order. UNVTD `totalOrderAmount`.

invoiceeParty.description: The party to be invoiced, when neither buyer nor seller. UNVTD `invoicee`.

TradeParty.title: TradeParty
TradeParty.description:
A party taking a role in a trade document, such as the buyer or the seller.
Only the name is mandatory: sample documents identify counterparties by name
alone, so requiring an address would reject a real document. The address,
role codes, identifiers and contacts are all inherited and optional.

identifier.description: A unique identifier of this trade party.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this trade party.

postalAddress.description: The postal address for this trade party.

Location.title: Location
Location.description:
A place named by a trade document, such as a destination or a place of
payment presentation. Use `locationFunctionTypeCode` to say which.

locationFunctionTypeCode.description: A code specifying the type of this logistics related location.

PaymentTerms.title: PaymentTerms
PaymentTerms.description:
The terms of payment agreed for a trade document. Carry the verbatim text in
`description` and the code list value in `paymentTermsTypeCode`.

paymentTermsTypeCode.description: A code specifying the type of trade payment terms.

DeliveryTerms.title: DeliveryTerms
DeliveryTerms.description:
The delivery terms of a trade document. The Incoterm goes in
`deliveryTermsDeliveryTypeCode` and its named place in `relevantLocation`;
weight basis, tolerance and tare rules have no typed slot and go verbatim in
`description`.

PaymentMeans.title: PaymentMeans
PaymentMeans.description:
The means by which a payment is to be made, such as a transfer, a cheque or
a documentary credit.

AllowanceCharge.title: AllowanceCharge
AllowanceCharge.description:
An allowance or a charge applied to a trade document. `chargeIndicator` is
mandatory because it is what distinguishes the two.

chargeIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not the trade allowance charge is a charge.

Measure.title: Measure
Measure.description:
A measured value such as a weight. The unit itself has no home:
IUneceMeasureCode declares no value property, so `MeasureTypeCode` cannot
carry "kgs".
